page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and several Hebrew stems are read from a small, blurred print and may be wrong; the most doubtful are marked [?]. Rad. נוּעַ in the vagari entry is also doubtful. The running head is two Hebrew letter pairs (ת נ left, נ ת right), which may be reversed. Jes. 58. 3 and Ps. 68. 3 were printed as "Jef." and "Pf.", read here as Jes. and Ps. The entries continue on the next page after "fugietis, fut. Kal, 2. f."
